summary: The main article describes a dual visible-light-cobalt catalytic system for the controllable isomerization of alkenes. It includes 5 tables for optimization and substrate scope, and 2 schemes illustrating the research context and proposed reaction mechanism.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: Isomerization of alkenes.
items.image_path: Angew Chem Int Ed - 2019 - Meng - Controllable Isomerization of Alkenes by Dual Visible‐Light‐Cobalt Catalysis_artifacts/image_000007_6ee1b4319449edb718e005679360b8f8457ffc0487bfe79011567cb56b52f5fd.png
items.description: This scheme provides context by showing previous work on metal-catalyzed and photochemical alkene isomerization alongside the current work's dual catalysis approach.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Screening of allylbenzene isomerization.
items.image_path: Angew Chem Int Ed - 2019 - Meng - Controllable Isomerization of Alkenes by Dual Visible‐Light‐Cobalt Catalysis_artifacts/image_000009_72f861f15455764568b0e7a9ea7abdc33dec66f7132bfd46c78667c5f1c3df0d.png
items.description: This table details the optimization of reaction conditions, including solvent screening and control experiments for the isomerization of allylbenzene.

items.heading: Table 2
items.caption: Scope of isomerizing alkenes into thermodynamically stable isomers.
items.image_path: Angew Chem Int Ed - 2019 - Meng - Controllable Isomerization of Alkenes by Dual Visible‐Light‐Cobalt Catalysis_artifacts/image_000010_9ecbb5853fa50733bf96fe2ff94e2ca80f1bffc664d646be3d23abcdf00d3f0b.png
items.description: This table explores the substrate scope for converting various terminal alkenes into their most thermodynamically stable internal isomers using Xantphos or 4CzIPN.

items.heading: Table 3
items.caption: Screen of ligand for the isomerization of 4-phenyl-1-butene.
items.image_path: Angew Chem Int Ed - 2019 - Meng - Controllable Isomerization of Alkenes by Dual Visible‐Light‐Cobalt Catalysis_artifacts/image_000013_a3d48cd3e5c7dcccb353ff4bee19564e153c4f0fddfad6087a19462a8fa38d25.png
items.description: This table shows the screening of various phosphine ligands to achieve regioselective isomerization over only one carbon position.

items.heading: Table 4
items.caption: Scope of isomerizing alkenes over one carbon.
items.image_path: Angew Chem Int Ed - 2019 - Meng - Controllable Isomerization of Alkenes by Dual Visible‐Light‐Cobalt Catalysis_artifacts/image_000014_c00c4055288da653a147eb532ea79ee10cbe557236f87e4fa25350223253280e.png
items.description: This table demonstrates the generality of the regioselective isomerization of terminal alkenes to 2-alkenes using the DPEphos ligand.

items.heading: Table 5
items.caption: Scope of isomerizing exocyclic alkenes.
items.image_path: Angew Chem Int Ed - 2019 - Meng - Controllable Isomerization of Alkenes by Dual Visible‐Light‐Cobalt Catalysis_artifacts/image_000017_146d0e2f6b96a5275746f7345f18dd7a9bb63696e685d89e563ff8950945f87d.png
items.description: This table presents the conversion of exocyclic alkenes, such as beta-pinene and cholesterol derivatives, into endocyclic products using 4CzIPN and Co(acac)2.
